base.summary: GB premium holds; storage refill steady; TTF tracks seasonal tightness; policy uncertainty sustains mild bid.

downside.summary: Von der Leyen strategic reserve proposal gains member state traction; mild weather and storage builds accelerate; demand softens.

upside.summary: Slovakia-Russia deal disrupts transit flows or cold weather extends demand; storage refill slows. TTF rallies on supply tail-risk.
